model.attention: five sliding-window layers followed by one full-attention layer

source_observation.default_attention_dispatch: hybrid prefill-side target verification with tree mask
source_observation.activation_quantization: dynamic per-token FP8 for dense linears on CUDA

hypothesis.cause: The tied BF16 LM-head GEMM selects a different M-shape implementation for multi-token target verification than for ordinary autoregressive decode; close top-two logits can therefore cross at temperature zero even when the verifier hidden row is otherwise equivalent.
hypothesis.intervention: Keep the 60-layer multi-token target forward unchanged, but reshape request-major verifier hidden rows and project each draft depth as one contiguous batch_size-row LM-head call. Reassemble logits in the original request-major order.
hypothesis.prediction: The candidate target top-two logits and argmax match ordinary decode at the first native divergence while retaining transformer, cache, and attention amortization. Only the final vocabulary projection becomes 12 decode-shaped calls.
hypothesis.falsifier: Any four-row candidate emitted-token mismatch or target argmax mismatch closes this LM-head mechanism and prevents the ten-row/c32 pair.

measurement_gate.conditional_work: Only exact four-row candidate tokens admit the ten-row exact token/tool suite and matched c32 control/candidate pair.
